Fixtures of public/science/imaging/decode/npy (ADR-0398 §SD8, verification
plan). Every file here is synthetic: written on 2026-11-21 by
gen_fixtures.py.txt with numpy 2.5.5 as the reference implementation
(numpy.save, numpy.lib.format.write_array, numpy.savez and
numpy.savez_compressed), from arrays the script computes. They carry no
third-party data and no licence beyond this repository's.

values.tsv is numpy's reading of every sample of every array the reader
reads, by C-order index ("nan" for NaN); members.tsv is numpy's listing of
the two archives, with each member's descr and shape.

{u1,u2,i2,i4,f4,f8}_{le,be}.npy  3 × 5, every kind in both byte orders
                                 (u1 only as '|u1'); float ones hold a NaN.
cube_u2.npy, nd4_i2.npy          3-D and 4-D arrays.
fortran_i4.npy, fortran2d_f8.npy, fortran4d_u1.npy
                                 Fortran-ordered 3-D, 2-D and 4-D arrays.
v2_f4.npy, v3_f4.npy             format versions 2.0 and 3.0.
single.npz                       numpy.savez of one array (stored).
multi.npz                        numpy.savez_compressed of four arrays
                                 (deflated): two images, a 1-D array and a
                                 boolean one.
bool, i8, u4, f2, c16, str, datetime, structured, line, object .npy
                                 refused, each by name; object.npy holds a
                                 pickle, which the reader never runs.
